data.notes: March 2027 is anchored by Sydney Mardi Gras weekend, big Forecourt/arena shows, and a strong electronic run at Carriageworks and White Bay Power Station.

events.title: Bruno Mars: The Romantic Tour
events.summary: Bruno Mars plays Accor Stadium in Sydney on The Romantic Tour. Live Nation lists Tyla as special guest and Anderson .Paak performing as DJ Pee .Wee.

events.title: Fatboy Slim: The Carriageworks Residency
events.summary: Resident Advisor lists Fatboy Slim at Carriageworks on Friday 5 March, one of three confirmed nights in the venue residency. The event page bills Norman Cook in an intimate Carriageworks setting.

events.title: Sasha & John Digweed Sydney 2027
events.summary: TMRW Music brings Sasha & John Digweed to White Bay Power Station for a four-hour progressive-house set, with a Sydney support bill including Robbie Lowe, Marcel Vogel, Ben Gomori, Jerk Boy, Mimi J, Reenie, Tunnel Signs and Timothy Love.

events.title: Apollo The Party: Mardi Gras 2027
events.summary: Apollo The Party is confirmed for Sunday 7 March at Metro Theatre as a major Sydney Gay & Lesbian Mardi Gras dance party. The event advertises an afternoon-to-night format across multiple spaces with trance, disco, vocal house and anthems.

events.title: Fatboy Slim: The Carriageworks Residency
events.summary: Fatboy Slim brings an intimate Carriageworks residency date to Sydney during Mardi Gras weekend, billed by RA as a house/electro event focused on Norman Cook returning to a closer club-style setting.

events.title: Jungle
events.summary: Jungle play Afterpay Arena in Sydney with Sports listed as featured artist on Live Nation. The Sydney date is part of their March 2027 Australia run.

events.title: The Avalanches
events.summary: The Avalanches return to the Sydney Opera House Forecourt with HAAi and additional guests to be announced. The Opera House lists the date as Sunday 7 March 2027 with gates at 6:00pm.

events.title: beabadoobee
events.summary: beabadoobee plays Afterpay Arena in Sydney Olympic Park. Ticketek confirms the date as Saturday 20 March 2027 at 8:00pm.

events.title: Madness
events.summary: Madness celebrate five decades of hits with a Sydney Opera House Forecourt show. The Opera House event page confirms Friday 5 March 2027 with gates at 6:00pm.

events.title: Tove Lo: ESTRUS Tour
events.summary: Tove Lo brings the ESTRUS Tour to Hordern Pavilion with special guest SALTY. Live Nation lists the Sydney show for Friday 5 March 2027.

events.title: The Script: Man In The Arena Tour 2027
events.summary: The Script bring the Man In The Arena Tour to Sydney’s Afterpay Arena with Picture This. Frontier Touring confirms the Sydney date for Saturday 27 March 2027.

events.title: The Island: Pop Yacht x Mardi Gras Takeover
events.summary: Pop Yacht takes over The Island on Sydney Harbour for a one-night Mardi Gras Friday edition: a five-hour sunset pop party with DJ Nic Holland and Erfaan, camp performances and 2000s-to-now anthems.

events.title: Nemzzz: Locked In Tour
events.summary: UK rapper Nemzzz brings the Locked In Tour to Enmore Theatre Sydney. Live Nation confirms the show for Thursday 18 March 2027.

events.title: Glass Island - GUSTAVO
events.summary: Glass Island’s Gustavo series returns as a harbour house party inspired by Mykonos, Tulum and Dubai, mixing Afro house, deep house and global club sounds aboard Sydney’s floating party venue.

events.title: The Early November & Hellogoodbye: 20 Years Young
events.summary: The Early November and Hellogoodbye bring their 20 Years Young co-headline tour to Factory Theatre. The venue lists the Sydney show for Friday 19 March 2027 at 7:30pm.

events.title: Sundaylicious Sydney | Mardi Gras
events.summary: Sundaylicious runs its Mardi Gras closing-Sunday party at Babylon from 3pm–10pm, positioned as a final-Sunday celebration before the festival weekend winds down.

events.title: InTooDeep - Sunset Boat Party
events.summary: InTooDeep’s Sydney Harbour sunset cruise runs on the 39-metre Inception with three levels, two stages, DJs open-to-close and a 400-person capacity focused on house, deep house, techno and club tunes.

events.title: R&B Throwbacks Day Party: Sydney
events.summary: Daytime Disco Australia brings its R&B Throwbacks day-party format to Mansions Potts Point, programming 90s and 00s R&B classics for a 3pm–8pm daytime dance floor.
